src/math.laws.ts::addition commutes.name: addition commutes
src/math.laws.ts::addition commutes.source: law.proved('addition commutes', (a: bigint, b: bigint) => a + b === b + a);

src/math.laws.ts::doubling is adding twi.source: law.proved('doubling is adding twice', (a: bigint) => a * 2n === a + a);

src/math.laws.ts::and commutes.name: and commutes
src/math.laws.ts::and commutes.source: law.proved('and commutes', (a: boolean, b: boolean) => (a && b) === (b && a));
